title: UI council: one turn of an absolute scoring round
description: Scores for the images of one turn, then a prioritized fix list. Written for docs/design/ui-council/BRIEF.md, section Absolute scoring.

reviewer.description: Who reviewed. The coordinator checks it against the spawn command.

model.description: The model id the reviewer runs as, such as gpt-6.1-sol.

version.description: The model version or build the reviewer reports for itself. Write unknown if it cannot tell.

effort.description: The reasoning effort of the session, such as high.

inputs.description: Every image sent in this turn, in the order attached.

file_name.description: The image's file name exactly as listed in the prompt.

sha256.description: The image's sha256 as listed in the prompt, 64 lowercase hex characters. Copy it from the prompt; never compute or invent one.

images.description: One entry per scored image, in the order attached.

file_name.description: The file name of the scored image, as in inputs.

set.description: hercule: a capture of the app under review. other-app: a screenshot of another app. calibration: an image of the app that the prompt marks as calibration. Only hercule images may be cited by a fix.

screen.description: The screen's name from ui-screens.ts. Use reference-app for a screenshot of another app (set other-app).

theme.description: The theme of the capture. Use the reference-* value for a screenshot of another app.

scale.description: The device pixel ratio of the capture.

scores.description: Exactly one entry per category, 11 in all, in the order of the brief. A null (unassessable) score is ignored by every aggregate.

score.description: A whole number from 0 to 10, or null when the category cannot be assessed from this image. Values outside 0 to 10 are rejected by the coordinator.

unassessable_reason.description: Null when score is a number. Otherwise why the image cannot show this category.

evidence.description: The visible evidence for the score: the element or region, with pixel coordinates in this image (x, y, width, height), and what is seen there. For a null score, what was looked for.

overall_note.description: Null in most cases. When the overall score differs by more than 2 points from the average of the other non-null category scores of this image, one sentence on why.

fixes.description: Prioritized: all MUST first, then SHOULD, then COULD. Only for images with set hercule. Empty when this turn found nothing to fix.

id.description: A short id that is unique in this output, such as F1.

priority.description: MUST: obstructs use or reading. SHOULD: repeated defect. COULD: localized polish.

images.description: The file names, exactly as listed in the prompt, of the images that show the problem. Only images with set hercule: an image of another app or a calibration image never produces a fix.

screens.description: The screens of the cited images.

themes.description: The themes of the cited images.

problem.description: The visible problem, with its evidence: image file name, region in pixels, and what is seen.

change.description: The proposed change with exact values, such as a token and its new value. A hypothesis: ui:metrics measures it before it counts.

file.description: The repo path of the file to change, or null when the reviewer could not find it.

line.description: The line in file, or null when file is null.

metric.description: The scripted metric this change should move, or none.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences on what the images show. No scores here.
